name: Normal Day Operations
description: Sunny day with full utility grid connectivity. Solar generation is high, and all demand, including vessel shore power, is served normally.

name: Grid Blackout Disruption
description: Utility grid goes offline during a storm. The system must rely on battery reserves, local solar, and backup generation to keep critical loads online.

name: Extreme Capacity Constraints
description: Grid is offline, solar generation is minimal due to heavy overcast conditions, and battery reserves are depleted. Serving critical operations is highly constrained.

name: Emergency Grid Failure, High Vessel Demand
description: Utility grid is unavailable during a high-demand vessel call. Solar is weak, battery reserves are limited, and backup generation is insufficient for full support.
